name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Schwoicher Bauer
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Schwoicher Bauer is located in Kufstein and offers comfortable apartments with alpine views. The working farm provides fascinating insights into traditional dairy farming. In the region, the Kufstein Fortress and the historic old town are popular sightseeing highlights. Alpine hikes into the Kaisergebirge mountains can be started right from the property. Guests also benefit from convenient public transport links for local excursions. Furthermore, a selection of farm-fresh products such as milk and eggs is readily available.
